targets.adjudication_verdict_basis: criteria_non_degenerate{} uses short keys (C_DISSOCIABLE) while interpretation.criteria[].name uses long names (C_DISSOCIABLE_low_cofire_distinct_positions). build_experiment_indexes._compute_adjudication builds its non_load_bearing exclusion set from criteria[].name and tests `str(k) not in non_load_bearing` against the short keys, so nothing is ever excluded and the legacy vacuity check trips on C_DISSOCIABLE:false -- a criterion the author explicitly tagged load_bearing:false. Verified by direct execution: as-shipped -> vacuous_pass; with keys renamed to match criteria[].name -> verified. The load-bearing criterion (C_DECIDABLE_instrument_returned_a_reading) passed and is non-degenerate. Same outcome class as V3-EXQ-783, different route (783 = exclusion absent; 830 = exclusion present but join key mismatched).

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Within-action-sequence monitoring and abort: SMA / pre-SMA and dorsomedial frontal contribution to ongoing-action monitoring, with the basal-ganglia stop pathway providing the abort. Canonical behavioural demonstration is interrupting a reach mid-flight when the target moves.
dependencies: a PERSISTENT representation of the committed motor program that outlives the moment of commitment -- the thing monitoring acts upon
a stop/abort pathway able to release the commitment
an error/mismatch signal computed against the remaining program
biological_reference.divergence: Not a biology divergence. REE implements the MONITOR (the mid-execution hook, correctly written, flagged and contract-covered) but not the PERSISTENT PROGRAM REPRESENTATION it must act on: _committed_trajectory is destroyed at the end of every tick by post_action_update. This is a missing-dependency signature, not evidence against the claim -- the mechanism has never had the substrate it needs to express itself.

midexec_unreachability_scope.question: why has MECH-321's R4 mid-execution hook never fired?
midexec_unreachability_scope.verdict: structurally unreachable under the standard driver loop -- NOT harness-, environment-, or commitment-config-dependent
midexec_unreachability_scope.mechanism: E3Selector.post_action_update's LAST statement is an unconditional `self._committed_trajectory = None` (e3_selector.py:3874, def at 3595, next def at 3877). REEAgent.update_residue calls it (agent.py:8599) and the 816-family driver -- which V3-EXQ-830 inherits verbatim -- calls update_residue on every step (line 293), immediately after select_action (line 290). The hook (agent.py:5501, inside select_action def 5252) requires a trajectory committed on a PREVIOUS tick, since it re-evaluates the REMAINING unexecuted content. Every previous tick ends by destroying it.
midexec_unreachability_scope.cannot_be_set_within_same_call: The sole setter is E3Selector.select at e3_selector.py:3499 under `if committed:`. Both in-select_action e3.select() call sites (agent.py:7513, 8520) are AFTER the hook at 5501, and the other selection path _e3_tick is invoked at 5151, outside select_action. Two conditional release sites (agent.py:5435, 5493) also clear the handle before the hook.
midexec_unreachability_scope.substrate_self_documentation: e3_selector.py:345 states the property directly -- _committed_trajectory is 'set ONLY under the F-driven `if committed:` path and torn down every tick by post_action_update'.

targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: Deliberately NOT substrate_ceiling. Nothing was tested and found wanting -- the R4 mechanism was never reachable. A ceiling reading would inflate the re-derive brake against MECH-321 for a mechanism that has never once run.
targets.recommended_epistemic_category_per_claim: MECH-288 and ARC-070 are peripheral here. 830 exercised ARC-070's decomposition machinery successfully pre-commit (214-322 decompositions per cell) and says nothing about MECH-288's OBSERVATION stream, where the slow scale is separately contracted. Only MECH-321 carries the implementation gap.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-830 (2026-07-27, diagnostic, PASS/non_contributory) exercised MECH-321's R1 pre-commitment decomposition at scale (11423 evaluations, 2393 sweeps, 5 seeds) and returned the pre-registered null slow_never_fires_on_rollout: with a live, varying z_goal stream present on 87% of sweeps (zgoal_norm_std 0.070 vs a 1e-4 floor) the MECH-288 slow BOCPD scale fired zero times on the rollout stream. The run's vacuous_pass adjudication flag was investigated and adjudicated a FALSE POSITIVE (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-830_2026-07-29): it is caused by criteria_non_degenerate keys being spelled shorter than the matching criteria[].name, defeating the V3-EXQ-783 load_bearing:false exclusion; corrected key spelling adjudicates verified. Separately, the same run establishes that MECH-321's R4 MID-EXECUTION phase has NEVER executed and is structurally unreachable under the standard driver loop -- E3Selector.post_action_update unconditionally clears _committed_trajectory every step (e3_selector.py:3874) while the hook requires cross-tick persistence (agent.py:5519, gate 4). MECH-321's R4 half is therefore UNTESTED, not unsupported; no ceiling reading applies. Retest after the persistent-commit-handle substrate lands.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Persistent committed-program handle so MECH-321's R4 mid-execution decomposition hook is reachable
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: E3Selector.post_action_update unconditionally clears _committed_trajectory as its last statement (e3_selector.py:3874), so the cross-tick mid-execution hook at agent.py:5519 (gate 4) can never see a committed trajectory. Build a persistent committed-program handle mirroring the existing _closure_committed_trajectory precedent -- set on commit entry, cleared on principled release / closure fire / episode reset, NOT cleared by post_action_update -- and point gate (4) at it. Default-off behind a flag so the OFF path stays bit-identical. NOT a pure diagnostic change: a reachable mid-execution hook can newly reach boundary.fired and RELEASE the commit latch, aborting the remaining macro.

learning_extracted: MECH-321's R4 mid-execution phase has never executed in any experiment and is structurally unreachable under the standard select_action -> update_residue loop: post_action_update unconditionally destroys _committed_trajectory every step while the hook requires cross-tick persistence.

A load_bearing exclusion keyed on exact string equality can be silently defeated by an author using two spellings for one criterion. The V3-EXQ-783 fix is correct but under-specified about its join key; nothing validates that criteria_non_degenerate keys correspond to criteria[].name.

A contract that reaches its target only via hand-injected preconditions proves reachability-in-principle, never reachability-in-practice. The anti-vacuity guard in test_mech321_scale_resolved_boundary.py is correct and still could not catch this -- it asserts the hook was reached GIVEN the injected state.
Phase-split counters earn their keep: decomp_n_evaluated_{precommit,midexec} were added to BOUND a dilution and instead exposed that an entire declared mechanism phase never runs.

A flag added to close a measurement asymmetry can be unreachable for the same reason the asymmetry was invisible -- use_decomposition_scale_resolved_probe_midexec modifies a dict inside a block that never executes.
830's zero mid-execution dilution is structural, which STRENGTHENS rather than qualifies the 2026-07-29 closure of the scoping spike's section 5b.

infrastructure_recommendations.description: WARN when an interpretation.criteria_non_degenerate key matches no interpretation.criteria[].name. Prevents new manifests acquiring the key-mismatch defect that defeats the V3-EXQ-783 load_bearing:false exclusion. No retroactive re-scoring.

Make the non_load_bearing exclusion in _compute_adjudication tolerate the short-key/long-name relationship: a criteria_non_degenerate key that is a prefix of exactly ONE criteria[].name inherits that criterion's load_bearing tag. Must be conservative -- match only on an unambiguous single prefix hit, never a fuzzy match -- so existing adjudications are unchanged except where the join was genuinely missed.
